executive_summary: The Maven build failed during compilation with 43 errors across multiple files. The primary root cause is missing Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Jakarta Persistence, and Apache Commons dependencies in the project. These missing dependencies prevent the compiler from resolving critical packages and annotations required for security configuration, data access, and entity management.

errors.message: Package org.springframework.security.* does not exist (4 security packages missing)
errors.root_cause: Spring Security dependency is missing from pom.xml. The SecurityConfig class requires spring-boot-starter-security but it is not declared in the project dependencies.

errors.message: Package org.springframework.data.jpa.repository and org.springframework.data.domain do not exist
errors.root_cause: Spring Data JPA dependency is missing from pom.xml. Repository interfaces require spring-boot-starter-data-jpa for JpaRepository, Query, Modifying, and Param annotations.

errors.message: Package jakarta.persistence does not exist (Entity, Table, Id, Column annotations missing)
errors.root_cause: Jakarta Persistence API is missing. JPA entities require jakarta.persistence package which is typically provided by spring-boot-starter-data-jpa but may need explicit declaration.
errors.fix_recommendation: Ensure spring-boot-starter-data-jpa is added to pom.xml (includes Jakarta Persistence API). If already present, verify Spring Boot version compatibility with Jakarta Persistence 3.x.

errors.root_cause: Apache Commons Lang3 dependency is missing from pom.xml. The ValidationUtils class requires commons-lang3 library.

errors.message: Package org.springframework.data.domain does not exist (Pageable, Page classes missing)
errors.root_cause: Missing Spring Data JPA dependency prevents import of Pageable and Page classes needed for pagination support in the controller.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add spring-boot-starter-data-jpa dependency to pom.xml as specified in error #2. This will resolve pagination-related imports.

errors.message: Cannot find symbol: EnableWebSecurity, HttpSecurity, SecurityFilterChain
errors.root_cause: Missing Spring Security dependency causes compilation failure for security configuration annotations and classes.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add spring-boot-starter-security dependency to pom.xml as specified in error #1. This will resolve all security-related compilation errors.
